extras: Warning: This is the author's first time developing a plugin and working with the Obsidian API.
intentEvidence: So now we get to keep the note ID pure while also maintaining an informative title in frontmatter.
motivation: The author questioned the necessity of writing titles in frontmatter, seeking a way to keep IDs pure while maintaining informative titles.
problem: Arbitrary note IDs make navigating the File Explorer difficult, especially when using the Zettelkasten method.
summary: A plugin that displays frontmatter aliases as the note's display name within the File Explorer.
